Probe 1 (probe1-holdout-comparison.raw.txt) regenerated seven fusions on DEFAULT_CASES, then scored both sources and every fusion on twelve unseen pairwise-composite holdout cases. Certified coverage margin is 0.101829 versus tournament 0.104762 (retention 0.972005). Probe 2 (probe2-permutation.raw.txt) ran an exact 3!^12 within-case label permutation: extreme=512064 of 2176782336, p=0.000235, five-name Bonferroni p=0.001176. Clean control retention 0.855186; distribution-shift-red drove the same control to RED. Condition 11 uses the per-unit manifest allowed by STRUCTURAL-CONDITION-11.
